name: Method development
scientific_purpose: Develop and maintain a structured catalog of feasible research methods without selecting a branch for the user.

current_record_semantics.research_meaning: The catalog presents the latest structured definition and scientific assessment for each method while preserving stable identity and lineage.
current_record_semantics.history_policy: Current in-scope method records are the default basis. Historical definitions and runs are opt-in and never silently merged.

user_choices.label: Method
user_choices.description: Select the stable method ID when focused-method scope is used.

user_choices.label: Research instructions
user_choices.description: State the methodological question, constraints, and emphasis.

user_choices.label: Selected history
user_choices.description: Optionally include named historical records for an explicit comparison.

user_choices.label: Researcher method specification
user_choices.description: Free-form text describing a proposed method for evaluation. May be markdown, a file path, or a link.

run_modes.label: Full catalog
run_modes.purpose: Add methods or update multiple method records as one catalog transaction.
entry_conditions: A current Phase 1 literature basis is formal and readable.

run_modes.label: Focused method
run_modes.purpose: Reassess or revise exactly one existing stable method without changing another method.
entry_conditions: The selected method exists and is active or explicitly reactivatable.
A current Phase 1 literature basis is formal and readable.

run_modes.label: Researcher proposal
run_modes.purpose: Evaluate a researcher-proposed method specification. If valid, register it as a new method in the catalog.
entry_conditions: A current Phase 1 literature basis is formal and readable.

prerequisites.description: A formal current project brief is readable.
A formal current Phase 1 literature basis is readable.

required_inputs.purpose: Preserve the scientific problem and intended scope.
Ground novelty, assumptions, comparisons, and substantive relevance.
Resolve the formal sources supporting method statements.
Expose the search boundaries and evidence gaps that constrain method novelty and scope.
Preserve stable identities and constrain the authorized update scope.
required_inputs.condition: Required after the first catalog run and absent on the first run.

required_inputs.purpose: Expose the current theory conclusion, scope, and assumptions when revising the method.
required_inputs.condition: Optional in focused_method mode when theory results exist for the selected method.

required_inputs.purpose: Expose the current empirical conclusion and boundary behavior when revising the method.
required_inputs.condition: Optional in focused_method mode when empirical results exist for the selected method.

required_inputs.purpose: Expose the current manuscript draft and its scope when revising the method.
required_inputs.condition: Optional in focused_method mode when manuscript results exist for the selected method.

supplementary_inputs.purpose: Accept researcher-supplied material (for example external method notes or prior drafts) as additional context for method development. It is additive only and never substitutes for published records.

optional_context_policy.description: Current literature and in-scope methods are loaded by default. Historical material is included only when the user selects it.

role_stages.objective: Generate independent proposals, scoped revisions, or evaluations of a researcher-proposed method from the same frozen basis. Proposals should seek unique literature positioning and high novelty relative to the frozen literature basis. Draft method records follow the catalog writing rules: a short title that pinpoints the core mechanic (a few words plus acronym, no subtitle clauses), and a summary of exactly two lines - one novelty-mechanism sentence, then the single equation that most sharply expresses the core idea.
role_stages.isolation_rule: Proposal roles do not read one another's current-run proposals before submission.

role_stages.objective: Cross-review definitions, assumptions, identifiability, implementation, data requirements, computation, empirical distinguishability, or the validity and novelty of a researcher-proposed method. Each review includes a structured per-method evaluation keyed by the method stable_id, within the reviewer competency axis.

Reconcile or expose disagreements and produce the candidate scoped catalog change and decision summary. For researcher proposals, decide whether the method warrants formal registration. The lead adjudicates and seals a 1-10 score with justification on three axes (theoretical validity and identifiability; literature positioning and novelty; empirical testability and computational efficiency) for every method in the change set. Seal titles as short display names that pinpoint the core mechanic (a few words plus acronym, no subtitle clauses) and summaries as exactly two lines - one novelty-mechanism sentence, then the single equation that most sharply expresses the core idea.

run_local_outputs.purpose: Preserve the theorist's independent construction or revision.
Preserve the analyst's independent implementation and empirical assessment.
Audit definitions, assumptions, identifiability, and inferential claims.
Audit implementability, study design, data needs, computation, and empirical distinguishability.
Provide complete structured candidate method records within the authorized scope.
Record each newly identified research-attention item with its exact basis, affected claim or record, and smallest resolving question.
Compare methods and explain innovation and material changes while leaving branch selection to the user.

validation_rules.description: Independent proposals, cross-reviews, and lead reconciliation obey the declared order and visibility.
Focused output changes only the selected stable method; full-catalog output changes only the declared change set.
Stable IDs remain permanent; calculation-defining changes advance the positive integer version by exactly one and change the digest; prose-only changes preserve both.
Formal claims cite formal Phase 1 sources. Unresolved new sources remain run-local until Phase 1 promotes them.
A retirement recommendation cannot change method lifecycle without a separate authenticated user action.
Every method record in the catalog change set carries an evaluation block with integer scores 1-10 and non-empty justifications on all three axes; issue_refs resolve to sealed review issues.

Theorist review reports evaluate only the theoretical_validity axis; data analyst review reports evaluate only the empirical_feasibility axis; literature positioning and novelty is adjudicated by the research lead alone.

promotion.failure_behavior: Keep the prior catalog and every method pointer unchanged; retain the candidate only in its run workspace.

downstream_effects.description: The latest method-bound records remain current in record position but cannot satisfy exact-method use until user-started replacement runs reassess the new identity.

researcher_questions: What is each method's innovation and exact definition?
Which methods have current exactly aligned P3 and P4 records?

fields.label: Methods
fields.meaning: Current methods with lifecycle, exact identity, definition, assumptions, and assessment.

fields.label: P3 and P4
fields.meaning: Separate publication, current-position, alignment, attention, and outcome indicators.

fields.label: What changed
fields.meaning: Additions, definition changes, no-change assessments, and retirement recommendations.
